title: Introduce elasticity-visor autoscaler and burst reconciler
author: Mariana Soto
description: Adds a new Elasticity Visor autoscaler and a burst reconciler layer for Dedicated fleets to improve throughput guarantees under short-lived surge patterns. Motivation: existing warm-pool heuristics overprovision or slow to react to microbursts, causing either cost waste or SLA slippage; this change introduces a gated scaling strategy plus reconciliation to reclaim ephemeral allocations and emit fine-grained utilization telemetry. High-level changes: 1) elasticity-visor controller that ingests per-pool utilization histograms and produces short-window reserve suggestions; 2) gated autoscaler policy that supports commit-windows, transient allowances, and a soft-throttle fallback path; 3) burst-reconciler service that detects drift between committed reservations and actual steady utilization and reclaims ephemeral credits with safety guardrails; 4) new telemetry pillars (util_hist_5s, surge_fraction, reclaim_events, commitment_delta) exposed to Prometheus and the Console; 5) rollout-first-as-canary with 10% of Dedicated fleets, metric-driven expansion and automatic rollback on error budgets. Implementation notes: the controller runs as a leader-elected deployment, uses an internal ring buffer for short-window aggregation to keep memory bounded, and ships a minimal protobuf wire format to the reconciler to minimize RPC pressure. Backwards compatibility: the gated policy is optional and disabled by default behind feature flag ff.elasticity_visor; when disabled behavior falls back to existing warm-pool decisions. Testing: unit tests for policy FSM, integration tests with local mock-fleet, and e2e simulated microburst harness included. Migration notes: customers with pinned reservations see no behavioral changes until the flag is enabled or rollout occurs. See linked Linear tickets for performance SLO targets and benchmark artifacts.

review_comments: Ethan Kim: Nice separation of concerns between controller and reconciler. Can you justify the 5s histogram bucket choice? It seems noisy for smaller tenants.
Mariana Soto: We picked 5s to capture microburst tail behavior; added an adaptive downsample path for tenants < 100 TPS to reduce noise (see gated_policy.go changes).
Ravi Patel: Observe a potential race in the leader election fallback; suggest a test that simulates lease collisions.
Mariana Soto: Added lease-collision unit test and a comment explaining optimistic backoff. Also added metrics around leader switchover duration.
Lina Ford: Please ensure we don't emit high-cardinality labels on surge_fraction. Requesting one more run of the e2e harness with 10k tenant simulation.
Mariana Soto: Removed tenant_id label from surge_fraction and added tenant_bucket label with bounded cardinality. Performed a larger e2e run, attached artifact in Linear ticket ENG-4321.
release_notes: Feature: Elasticity Visor autoscaler and burst reconciler for Dedicated fleets. Rollout behind feature flag ff.elasticity_visor. Adds new metrics util_hist_5s, surge_fraction, reclaim_events. Ops: runbook and rollback procedure included.
